value.rationale: The maximum size and full size distribution of an atomic event that the owner can know while remaining nontrivial for each other agent are natural resources/invariants for a newly defined local-state secrecy modality. The theorem answers them for every finite complete-product chromatic simplicial model, not a single small example. It also detects the precise owner-resource boundary n_a=1 and gives exact multiplicities of extremal admissible events, useful for semantic examples and model construction; no cryptographic claims are made.
